excerpts.text:
hey I'm Rob McGee and this is a no frills guide 
to brewing great coffee with the French press
okay this is a 34 ounce French press that I 
bought at the grocery store have pre warmed
it with tap water I also have a full kettle 
of filtered water it's about a minute or so
off the boil and that's gonna be about two 
hundred to two hundred and five degrees which
is the brewing temperature we want we're gonna 
use ten level tablespoons of ground coffee the
grind size here is coarse and your local coffee 
shop can grind that coffee or if you're using
the grinder of the grocery store it'll have a 
French press setting on it go ahead and start
your timer now go ahead and start to pour your 
water in we're pouring this halfway up and then
we're gonna let it sit for thirty seconds to 
let any gas escape this is going to be about
a sixteen to one water to coffee brew ratio 
when your timer hits thirty seconds go ahead
